name: THE IRON LEDGER: Cross-Category Combat Parlay Exchange
subcategory: gray-market parlay exchange / cross-category combat betting
description: The Iron Ledger is a semi-formalized gray-market exchange operating across Tier 2 districts and the corponation quarter zones, specializing in cross-category combat parlays that link human fighter outcomes from underground circuits with autonomous machine demolition events and augmented league results into single compound bets. The operation runs through a distributed BCI mesh that has no fixed physical address — bettors connect via an encrypted neural handshake and wagers are settled in Quanta through untraceable micro-transaction chains. The Ledger's anonymous architects are rumored to be former OmniPhi compliance engineers who stripped the platform's regulatory architecture and rebuilt it for the underground.
story_hooks: The Iron Ledger's anonymous architects are preparing to sell the platform to an unknown buyer — the Gray Zone betting community suspects it is a corponation front that will harvest bettor identity data accumulated over years of 'anonymous' transactions.

A series of statistically impossible cross-category parlays have paid out over six weeks, all placed by different apparent accounts but with identical neural signature artifacts — someone is either fixing results across multiple combat categories simultaneously or exploiting a fundamental flaw in the platform's odds engine.

A runner for the Ledger's physical settlement arm — who hand-delivers winnings to bettors who can't receive digital transfers — has been quietly memorizing every face and address she visits, and someone has noticed.
